decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY capturing removal of the purple-marked walls and leaving the counter side open; refrigerator placement belongs only to the kitchen-cabinetry Requirement.
The corridor concern is independently captured by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event, and the kitchen counter and refrigerator changes do not alter the corridor Requirement.
The counter-side and refrigerator-placement changes do not affect Unit 3 bathroom geometry or fixtures.
The kitchen-layout changes do not alter the requirement to show room dimensions.
